whatIs.title: What Is a Single Tooth Implant?
paragraphs: A single tooth implant is one of the most effective solutions for replacing a missing tooth without affecting neighboring teeth.

The treatment involves placing a titanium implant into the jawbone, where it functions as an artificial tooth root. Once the implant integrates with the bone, a custom-made dental crown is attached to restore your smile naturally.
